**Coverage totals (35 real samples): 0 fully covered today, 20 partial, 15 gap, 4 n-a.** No sample is 100% covered because virtually every Noesis sample uses Storyboards; conversely none is 0% — layout, resources, shapes, styling, triggers, and core binding are solid everywhere.

# Prioritized Enhancement Plan

Effort scale: S = days, M = 1-3 weeks, L = 4+ weeks. "Unblocks" counts samples materially advanced (not necessarily completed alone). Feasibility notes are specific to bevy_ui/Bevy 0.19.

## Ranked feature increments

**1. Transforms + subtree opacity (M) — prerequisite tier, touches ~24 samples**
RenderTransform/TransformGroup/RenderTransformOrigin mapped onto Bevy 0.19's native `UiTransform` (translation/rotation/scale exist; skew must be approximated or skipped with a warning); MatrixTransform decomposition. Subtree Opacity via the already-sketched alpha-multiply design (walk descendants, multiply into BackgroundColor/TextColor/ImageNode alpha) since bevy_ui has no per-node opacity. Nothing animated is portable without this, so it goes first despite unblocking nothing alone.

**2. Storyboard/animation core (L) — unblocks ~26 samples; the single biggest lever**
Clock + Storyboard scheduling (BeginTime, Duration, RepeatBehavior/Forever, AutoReverse, Accel/DecelRatio); Double/Color/Point/Thickness/Object/Boolean animations, *UsingKeyFrames with Discrete/Linear/Easing/Spline keyframes; the full WPF easing set (Sine..Elastic, EasingMode). Values write into the existing provider store at a new animation layer above BaseValueSourceInternal (WPF semantics: animation composes over base value — the conformance notes' "Animation modifier" fits the store exactly, and structural revert already exists for triggers). Property-path resolution incl. indexed paths `(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)` and brush sub-properties `(Panel.Background).(Brush.Opacity)` — requires animatable sub-objects for transforms/brushes in the store. Delivery: EventTrigger(Loaded/Click/MouseEnter)+BeginStoryboard at Style/element/template level, Trigger.EnterActions/ExitActions, named storyboards startable from Rust (`PfStoryboards::begin("Intro")`), Completed signal. Split: 2a engine+Double/Color (M), 2b remaining types+keyframes+indexed paths (M), 2c EventTrigger/EnterActions/code API (S).
Unblocks fully: HelloWorld, CustomAnimation (add custom-curve trait), Detroit (with #4). Advances: nearly everything else.

**3. Command binding (S) — unblocks 12 samples**
ICommand analog: commands registered on Bindable VMs (name → Rust closure + optional can_execute), `Command=`/`CommandParameter=` (bound or literal) on Button-family, Hyperlink, MenuItem; CanExecute → IsEnabled through the provider store. Cheap, high fan-in (Commands, Buttons, Menu3D, TicTacToe, Login, LayeredUI, Widget3D, NorthGame, Inventory, Rive, SciFi, Persona5). Completes **Commands** together with #4's ElementName.

**4. Binding power-ups (M) — unblocks ~15 samples**
ElementName= (resolve via existing XamlNames namescopes, incl. ActualWidth/ActualHeight as bindable sources — post-layout feed from ComputedNode); RelativeSource Self/TemplatedParent/AncestorType (TemplatedParent also closes ControlTemplate gate 5 → ComboBox/Expander re-templating); IValueConverter as a Rust trait registered by resource key + ConverterParameter; MultiBinding/IMultiValueConverter; FallbackValue/TargetNullValue; OneWayToSource; BooleanToVisibilityConverter built-in; x:Static for enum values (Visibility etc.); noesis:Loc-style localization extension as sugar over existing deferred DynamicResource + dictionary swap (S, fold in here — Localization then nearly closes).
Completes: Commands, UserControl (with #9's DPs), Localization, DataBinding (with #8 item templating), Scoreboard (with #2 hover anims).

**5. VisualStateManager (M, after #2) — unblocks 13 samples**
VisualStateGroups/VisualState/VisualTransitions (GeneratedDuration/GeneratedEasingFunction) parsed inside ControlTemplates; states entered by mapping the existing trigger-condition machinery (hover/pressed/focus/checked/enabled) to CommonStates/FocusStates/CheckStates; GoToState from Rust + GoToStateAction. Implementation is thin over #2: a state = a storyboard applied at the template-trigger tier with cross-fade transition. Advances Buttons, Detroit, Login, SciFi, NorthGame, Persona5, Widget3D, WorldSpaceUI, RenderTexture, QuestLog, ApplicationTutorial, BrushShaders, Gallery.

**6. Interactivity behaviors (M) — unblocks ~12 samples**
Microsoft.Xaml.Behaviors namespace: Interaction.Triggers/Behaviors; EventTrigger, KeyTrigger, b:DataTrigger + ConditionBehavior/Comparison, PropertyChangedTrigger, StoryboardCompletedTrigger; actions: InvokeCommandAction, ChangePropertyAction, ControlStoryboardAction, GoToStateAction, SetFocusAction/SelectAllAction, PlaySoundAction (bevy_audio one-shots), LaunchUriOrFileAction (reuse Hyperlink's opener). Straightforward ECS observers + the #2/#3/#5 primitives. Completes LayeredUI; advances Login, Menu3D, Inventory, QuestLog, NorthGame, Rive, Gallery, RadialMenu.

**7. Pointer surface, capture & drag-drop (S/M) — unblocks 6 samples**
Expose MouseDown/Move/Up/Enter/Leave (Bevy picking has all of these) as XAML-attribute handlers routed to registered Rust observers + CaptureMouse equivalent (route-all-to-entity flag); hit-test helper (bounds intersection via ComputedNode); drag-ghost pattern helper (overlay layer already exists). Optional M extension: manipulation recognizer (pan/pinch/rotate + inertia) over Bevy touch input for **Touch**. Completes ActionBar; advances BlendTutorial, Inventory, RenderTexture, Touch, DopesBench.

**8. Control & templating gaps (M) — unblocks ~10 samples**
PasswordBox (TextBox variant: mask char, PasswordLength, no clipboard-out); RepeatButton with Delay/Interval; UniformGrid; HeaderedContentControl; ContentControl with Content={Binding VM} + implicit DataTemplates keyed by VM Rust type (DataType) — the LayeredUI/MVVM view-switching pattern; ListBox SelectedItem TwoWay binding + ItemContainerStyle + custom ItemsPanel (ItemsPanelTemplate incl. Canvas/UniformGrid/horizontal); ScrollBar/ScrollViewer/Track/Thumb re-templating (existing plan gate 4) then Slider/ProgressBar/ListBoxItem/ComboBox templates (gate 5, needs #4 TemplatedParent). Completes DataBinding, QuestLog (minus BlurEffect), LayeredUI, Gallery controls pages; advances Login, SciFi, ApplicationTutorial, BlendTutorial, Scoreboard.

**9. Custom-element authoring API (M/L) — unblocks 7 samples**
Public API to register Rust types for `xmlns:local` clr-namespace: custom controls with declared properties living in the provider store (DP analog: default, changed-callback, bindable/animatable), lookless default style + template swap; UserControls with exposed properties; custom panels (measure/arrange trait); custom shapes (Arc — tiny-skia already rasterizes arbitrary geometry); custom animation curves (trait hook into #2); immediate-mode canvas element (OnRender analog: tiny-skia DrawingContext + per-frame invalidation) for CustomRender-style ports. Completes CustomControl, UserControl, NineSlice (or take the cheap S route first: map to Bevy's native ImageNode 9-slice), RadialMenu, CustomAnimation, CustomRender.

**10. Focus & directional navigation (M) — unblocks 6 samples**
Tab order + KeyboardNavigation.TabNavigation/DirectionalNavigation (Cycle/Contained), FocusScope, IsFocused/IsKeyboardFocused as trigger conditions (closes a listed ControlTemplate residual), programmatic focus, gamepad dpad→directional moves. Advances Buttons, Menu3D, Persona5, Login, Gallery, TicTacToe — the game-menu samples are focus-driven, not hover-driven.

**11. Brush/image upgrades + cheap effects (M) — unblocks ~8 samples**
ImageBrush as fill (Stretch, tile/SpreadMethod, Viewbox sub-rect w/ Absolute units — rasterize via tiny-skia for shapes, atlas-UV for rectangles); gradient SpreadMethod=Reflect/Repeat; DropShadowEffect approximated with bevy_ui's native BoxShadow (rectangular only — warn on shaped); OpacityMask for shape content (tiny-skia mask). Advances ActionBar, NineSlice, TicTacToe, QuestLog, Login, Detroit, RadialMenu, NorthGame.

**12. Shader effects & backdrop blur (L — custom render work)**
Two distinct pipelines: (a) custom brush shaders → bevy_ui `UiMaterial` with WGSL + storyboard-driven uniforms — this is the natural Bevy fit and unblocks BrushShaders; (b) BlurEffect/BackgroundEffectBehavior/ShaderEffect on arbitrary content → subtree/backdrop render-to-texture + post pass (custom render-graph node; bevy_ui has no backdrop-filter, real engineering). Blend modes ride along. Unblocks BackgroundBlur, BrushShaders; advances ApplicationTutorial, QuestLog, Persona5, VideoEffect. Do (a) before (b).

**13. Long tail / deferred (L, low ROI)**
MediaElement video (3rd-party decode crate, feature-gated) — VideoEffect; rive-rs RiveControl — Rive; per-element CompositeTransform3D (only truly possible in world-space mode where real 3D transforms exist; 2D-approximate in screen-space with a warning) — Menu3D/Inventory/TicTacToe polish; PointAnimation into live PathGeometry figures + Clip-bound-to-Path (Persona5's hand-drawn highlight) as an advanced #2 extension; render-to-texture Image glue for RenderTexture (actually S — Bevy-native, can be done anytime as an example).

## Recommended order

| Phase | Increments | Rationale | Completes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | #3 Commands (S), #4 Bindings (M) | Cheap, independent, prerequisites everywhere; #4 also closes template gate 5 | Commands, Localization, UserControl* |
| 2 | #1 Transforms/opacity (M) → #2 Storyboards (L) | The big unlock; everything animated depends on it | HelloWorld, CustomAnimation, Detroit-core |
| 3 | #5 VSM (M), #6 Behaviors (M) | Thin layers over #2/#3; together they flip most "gap" samples to "partial-high" | Buttons, LayeredUI, Widget3D, TicTacToe |
| 4 | #7 Pointer/DnD (S/M), #8 Controls/templates (M) | Interaction + master-detail samples | ActionBar, DataBinding, QuestLog, Login, Scoreboard, Touch* |
| 5 | #9 Authoring API (M/L), #10 Focus nav (M), #11 Brushes (M) | Extensibility samples + game-menu polish | CustomControl, UserControl, NineSlice, RadialMenu, CustomRender, Menu3D, Detroit, SciFi |
| 6 | #12 Shaders/blur (L) | Custom render; UiMaterial half first | BrushShaders, BackgroundBlur, NorthGame, Inventory |
| 7 | #13 Long tail | Opportunistic/feature-gated | VideoEffect, Rive, Persona5, WorldSpaceUI full |

Acceptance strategy (matching the repo's corpus-gated style): gate phase 2 on HelloWorld's MainWindow.xaml animating unadapted; gate phase 3 on Buttons + LayeredUI; keep NorthGame (65 states, 400+ keyframes) and Persona5 (geometry-point animation, clip bindings) as the end-game conformance stress tests. Repo docs to extend: docs/controltemplate-plan.md (gates 4-5 land in phases 1/4) and docs/wpf-samples-porting.md blocked list (storyboard items clear in phase 2-3).
